lines.name: Harbour Line
lines.beyond: north off-sheet along Harbour Road and west off-sheet along Crown Road; both termini off-sheet

notes: Fixes the N-R1 reach fault. T2 keeps tide's Harbour Line on Harbour Road and runs it round the primary ring as a U: Harbour Road (x 306), Comet Row (z -726), Sunset Way (x -346 shifting to -334), then Crown Road (z 286). Both ends leave the sheet: (306,320) on the y edge and (-400,286) on the x edge. No in-sheet end means no T-L1 loop, which is what blocked T2 before.

Reach from T2's centreline: harbour-east 44 m, docks-east 44 m, rocket-west 74 m, lantern-west 74 m, all well inside 250. Vantage has to put stops near those z values (about -267, -512 on the east side; -296, -563 on the west). Corner fillets are r50, the running minimum; the shift on Sunset Way is r100.

T-C1: at each corner the track sits 6 m off the road centre on the outer side, so the r50 arc stays inside the union of the two 24 m roads. I checked by hand at the track centreline and both tracks (±1.8). At Harbour Rd × Comet Row no point is at x>300 and z<-720, the uncovered corner, because Harbour Road starts at z -720.

Sunset Way shift: the right turn from Comet Row needs the track on the west side (x -346), and the left turn onto Crown Road needs it on the east side (x -334). It crosses the 4 m median between z -660 and -600 (11.3°). The median is inside the road width; tracks stay within x -347.8 to -332.2.

T2 crosses T1 on the flat at Boulevard × Comet Row (0,-726). The standards have no rule for a flat tram crossing; flagging it for Splice/Keel in case one is needed. S1 passes over T2 on Harbour Road at z 0 (grade-separated by the 24 m height).

N-C1 interchange candidates: T2 Harbour Road stop near (306,0 to 40) with S1 Harbour (340,0), under 60 m. T2 Comet Row stop near (-40,-726) with T1 Comet Row (0,-690), about 55 m. T2 Sunset Way stop near (-334,0) is 174 m from S1 Sphere Gardens (-160,0), over the 150 limit, so it can't pair with that station.

Kept T1 and S1 unchanged. The checker has NOT been run (I have no shell here); all of the above is checked by hand. The source mismatch from last time still stands: notes/why describes the old draft and contradicts notes/concept. Reported to Aster.
Tide's two-way Sky Loop is still rejected: r70 corners on the ring cut about 29 m in, over built plots (S-C1). T2 on the same ring at street level gives the edge coverage the loop was meant to give.

handoffs.ask: Place T2 Harbour Line stops, 300–500 m apart, on straight track. Cover harbour-east (≈306,-267), docks-east (≈306,-512), rocket-west (≈-334,-296) and lantern-west (≈-334,-563). Add interchanges: T2 stop near (306,0..40) ↔ S1 Harbour (340,0), and T2 Comet Row stop near (-40,-726) ↔ T1 Comet Row (0,-690). Keep stops off the curves at the corners (r50) and off the Sunset shift (z -680 to -590).
New tram line T2 Harbour Line (ring U, termini off-sheet). It needs a timetable, and its headways must work with T1 at the flat crossing (0,-726).
